findings.summary: 判据 1 cannot hold: `npm run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, tsconfig include ["src","test"], strict) fails on the delivered test file. The helpers `termState`/`boardState` annotate `Partial<TerminationState>`/`TerminationState` and `Partial<BoardState>`/`BoardState`, but neither name is imported — the file's only imports are runChannelWrite/assembleGenerateDeps/DEFAULT_AGENT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS/RunExitedWithoutDocError from ../src/tick-run, hasRunExited/InspectMessage from ../src/tick-inspect, DEFAULT_TICK_CONFIG from ../src/tick. Both interfaces are declared only as `export interface` in src/tick.ts:110 and src/tick.ts:333, and there is no ambient/global declaration anywhere in the tree (no .d.ts files exist), so this is TS2304 'Cannot find name'. vitest strips types without checking, so the suite can be green while the acceptance command chain is red.

判据 2b (GT-15/GT-16) is still not discriminative — the prior final review's blocker is unresolved. The test stubs `fetch` wholesale and mocks `node:child_process.spawn`, then asserts `result.timings.totalMs < node_timeout*1000*0.5` (= 900000ms). With all I/O mocked the elapsed time is a handful of milliseconds, so the required discriminant fails: reverting §1.1 by setting node_timeout back to 30 makes the bound 15000ms and the assertion still passes green. The spec requires the case to drive a real `--run` on a seed board and additionally assert that `termination` is readable; the test asserts nothing about `termination`. This is verbatim the GT-23 anti-pattern ("判据 2b 把 fetch 与 node:child_process.spawn 全 mock 掉，elapsed 天然是几毫秒").

判据 2a (GT-19) still has no test that drives the entry — the prior final review's blocker is unresolved, and the new test is the exact anti-pattern GT-23 names. It reads bin/e0-regression.sh as text and compares the byte offsets of the literals "HIT WALL CLOCK LIMIT" and "HIT ATTEMPT LIMIT" to decide which check comes first, which GT-23 records verbatim as not acceptable. bin/e0-regression.sh is never executed, the required situation (wall-clock budget still available but attempt count exhausted ⇒ the entry must continue) is never constructed, and nothing asserts the entry continues: at bin/e0-regression.sh:402-413 the attempt limit still breaks the loop with LOOP_EXIT=4 regardless of remaining wall clock, so only the profile's 40-vs-20 arithmetic keeps attempts from binding first and no executing test protects that.

判据 3's discriminant is a source-text assertion that the test's own title admits is non-discriminative ("discriminant: hasRunExited deleted from call sites would leave tests green" — it only asserts src/tick-inspect.ts contains the string "export function hasRunExited"). The generate side is genuinely covered by the preceding case (it drives deps.spawnRuntime.readBody with a 900000ms budget and bounds the poll count), but the triage readResult wait loop at src/tick-run.ts:1638-1658 has no test that bounds its waiting; restoring the dead-wait there would leave the suite green.

`hasRunExited` is imported but never used as a value in this file (the case that would use it asserts on source text instead). Harmless today because noUnusedLocals is not enabled, but it advertises coverage the file does not have.

Three of the six blockers from the previous attempt's final review are genuinely fixed. (1) The triage path now records-and-continues: readResult writes the named diagnostic and returns [] instead of throwing, so a triage run that exits without a dr-triage.result.v1 no longer escalates into a non-zero tick, while the reverse case (bus unreachable) still throws. (2) `timings` now exists and covers the whole tick including the generate segment (totalMs is measured after runGenerate), satisfying GT-21. (3) MAX_CLUES is now declared by the regression profile (MAX_CLUES=16) and wired end-to-end: bin/deep-research-loop.sh:127 exports it, fleet.yaml.tpl:28 injects `max_clues: ${MAX_CLUES}`, workflow.yaml:40 carries it in the seed payload, tick.md:59 passes `--max-clues`, and src/tick-run.ts:1972-1979 parses it. Both diagnostics now name run_id, role and the already-waited duration, and the declared headroom (1.99×) matches the asserted one.

This final judgment is independent of the Continuous review committed in the RC subject (rc-attempt_01KZX7KGHVH9JMZQRB9FX4VM7R, APPROVE with zero findings, reviewer glm/code-plan). That verdict is recorded but not adopted: it surfaces none of the typecheck break or the two unresolved discriminativeness blockers carried over from rf-attempt_01KZX60PFSRGK0T2K12Z3MRD8K.
